acceptanceCriteria: A numbered deviation selects a Corvint loop target whose base..target range adds no sealed CEM (for example the last pre-seal commit of the head PR), or drops the seal from the loop clone as the refusal instructs, with the reason recorded.
The Corvint run reaches a C3 verdict on the next candidate.
body: The Corvint preregistration (digest 58d68a6f...) pins corpus head 94ca556f, a merge of PR #287 whose first-parent range fc594fa6..94ca556f adds .corvint/changes/429e920c...cem.json. The harness loop runs dogfood change at base=head^ and target=head, and the candidate correctly refuses `dogfood-change: REFUSE sealed-cem-in-change` (reproduced on a clone at 94ca556f with the rc.1 binary). Every Corvint merge carries its PR's seal commit, so the loop rehearsal (C3) can never bind on a Corvint merge target. The beamfall/core target e8655b08 is a single-parent commit with no sealed CEM and is not affected.
title: Corvint untouched-repository preregistration pins the loop target at a PR merge whose range adds a sealed CEM
